statement.text:
For a finite group G and a permutation group K, let bG (K) denote the
number of conjugacy classes of regular subgroups of K isomorphic to G. Does there
exist a function f such that bG (K) ⩽ nf (r) for every abelian group G of order n and
rank r, and every group K such that K (2) = K? (See Archive 19.67 for the definition
of K (2) .)                                                           I. Ponomarenko
